use codegen_runtime::{
    BasicSourceRoots, DocumentMember, ExecutionContext, GroupedItems, Instance,
    InvocationCounterLimits, NamedInput, OwnedSourceLimits, RuntimeError, ScopeContext, Value,
};
use std::{cell::Cell, path::Path};
const OWNER: &[&str] = &["Interchange", "Group", "Message_850"];

fn reject<'a>(
    context: &ScopeContext<'a>,
    body: &'a dyn codegen_runtime::DocumentBodyClock,
    filename: &'a dyn codegen_runtime::DocumentFilenameClock,
) {
    let result = mfd051_native_guard_r7::prepare_native_x12_nullable_message(
        context,
        Some(body),
        Some(filename),
    );
    assert!(
        matches!(
            &result,
            Err(RuntimeError::Function(
                codegen_runtime::FunctionError::InvalidArgument {
                    function: "native_x12_message_binding",
                    ..
                }
            ))
        ),
        "entry must refuse before any branch, clock or row: {result:?}"
    );
}

fn counters(value: &Instance) -> Vec<String> {
    value
        .field("rows")
        .unwrap()
        .as_repeated()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|row| {
            assert_eq!(
                row.field("mapped").unwrap().as_scalar(),
                Some(&Value::String("safe".into()))
            );
            match row.field("counter").unwrap().as_scalar().unwrap() {
                Value::String(value) => value.clone(),
                other => panic!("counter was not serialized as text: {other:?}"),
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).ok_or("need input")?);
    let physical = mfd051_native_guard_r7::parse_native_primary_x12_source(&std::fs::read(&path)?)?;
    let execution = ExecutionContext::new(Path::new("neutral.mfd")).with_invocation_counter_limits(
        InvocationCounterLimits {
            max_counters: 4,
            max_text_bytes: 1024,
        },
    );
    let body_calls = Cell::new(0);
    let filename_calls = Cell::new(0);
    let body = || {
        body_calls.set(body_calls.get() + 1);
        Ok("2026-10-24T12:00:00".to_string())
    };
    let filename = || {
        filename_calls.set(filename_calls.get() + 1);
        Ok("2026-10-25T13:00:00".to_string())
    };
    let root = ScopeContext::with_execution_context(&physical, &execution);
    let messages = root.walk_source(OWNER);
    assert_eq!(messages.len(), 3);
    reject(&root, &body, &filename);
    for message in &messages {
        let duplicates = message.walk_source(OWNER);
        assert_eq!(duplicates.len(), 3);
        for duplicate in &duplicates {
            reject(duplicate, &body, &filename);
        }
        for row in message.walk_source(&["Rows"]) {
            reject(&row, &body, &filename);
        }
    }
    let groups = GroupedItems::by(vec![(messages[0].clone(), Value::String("g".into()))], None);
    let grouped = groups.contexts();
    assert!(!grouped.is_empty());
    for group in &grouped {
        reject(group, &body, &filename);
        let members = group.walk_source(&[]);
        assert!(!members.is_empty());
        for member in &members {
            assert_eq!(member.position(OWNER), 1);
            assert_eq!(
                member.resolve_source_field(&["BEG", "F1"])?,
                Value::String("A".into())
            );
            reject(member, &body, &filename);
            assert!(
                member
                    .native_x12_message_field(9999, OWNER, &["BEG", "F1"])
                    .is_err()
            );
        }
    }
    let named_inputs = [NamedInput {
        name: "Other",
        instance: &physical,
    }];
    let named =
        ScopeContext::with_named_inputs_and_execution_context(&physical, &named_inputs, &execution);
    let named_messages = named.walk_source(&["Other", "Interchange", "Group", "Message_850"]);
    assert_eq!(named_messages.len(), 3);
    for message in &named_messages {
        reject(message, &body, &filename);
    }
    let empty_primary = Instance::Group(Vec::new().into());
    let alias_inputs = [NamedInput {
        name: "Interchange",
        instance: physical.field("Interchange").unwrap(),
    }];
    let alias_root = ScopeContext::with_named_inputs_and_execution_context(
        &empty_primary,
        &alias_inputs,
        &execution,
    );
    let alias_messages = alias_root.walk_source(OWNER);
    assert_eq!(alias_messages.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(alias_messages[0].position(OWNER), 1);
    assert_eq!(
        alias_messages[0].resolve_source_field(&["BEG", "F1"])?,
        Value::String("A".into())
    );
    for message in &alias_messages {
        reject(message, &body, &filename);
        assert!(
            message
                .native_x12_message_field(9999, OWNER, &["BEG", "F1"])
                .is_err()
        );
    }
    let primary_with_alias =
        ScopeContext::with_named_inputs_and_execution_context(&physical, &alias_inputs, &execution);
    let primary_messages = primary_with_alias.walk_source(OWNER);
    assert_eq!(primary_messages.len(), 3);
    for message in &primary_messages {
        message.require_native_x12_message(OWNER)?;
    }
    let ordinary = ScopeContext::with_named_inputs(&physical, &[]);
    for message in ordinary.walk_source(OWNER) {
        message.require_native_x12_message(OWNER)?;
    }
    // A Basic endpoint remains nonnative even though its owner is named
    // Primary and its legacy projection contains the physical input value.
    let basic_roots = BasicSourceRoots::try_new(
        &physical,
        &[],
        OwnedSourceLimits {
            max_roots: 4,
            max_active_frames: 32,
            max_path_segments: 64,
            max_metadata_bytes: 1_048_576,
            max_walk_contexts: 4096,
        },
    )?;
    let basic = basic_roots.root_context()?;
    let basic_with_execution = basic_roots.root_context_with_execution(&execution)?;
    for legacy in [basic.legacy_view(), basic_with_execution.legacy_view()] {
        assert!(
            legacy.next_primary_source(&physical).is_none(),
            "a Basic legacy root is not a physical-primary transition source"
        );
        let basic_messages = legacy.walk_source(OWNER);
        assert_eq!(basic_messages.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(
            basic_messages[0].resolve_source_field(&["BEG", "F1"])?,
            Value::String("A".into())
        );
        for message in &basic_messages {
            reject(message, &body, &filename);
            assert!(
                message
                    .native_x12_message_field(9999, OWNER, &["BEG", "F1"])
                    .is_err()
            );
        }
    }
    assert_eq!((body_calls.get(), filename_calls.get()), (0, 0));
    let mut observed = Vec::new();
    for message in &messages {
        let document = mfd051_native_guard_r7::prepare_native_x12_nullable_message(
            message,
            Some(&body),
            Some(&filename),
        )?
        .unwrap();
        observed.extend(counters(document.value()));
    }
    assert_eq!(observed, ["1", "2", "3", "4"]);
    assert_eq!((body_calls.get(), filename_calls.get()), (3, 3));

    // A physical document-origin frame is not a second matching message owner.
    body_calls.set(0);
    filename_calls.set(0);
    let documents = Instance::DocumentSet(vec![
        DocumentMember::new_source("origin.x12", "resolved-origin.x12", physical.clone()).unwrap(),
    ]);
    let origin_root = ScopeContext::with_execution_context(&documents, &execution);
    reject(&origin_root, &body, &filename);
    let origin_messages = origin_root.walk_source(OWNER);
    assert_eq!(origin_messages.len(), 3);
    for message in &origin_messages {
        assert_eq!(
            message.source_document_path()?,
            Value::String("resolved-origin.x12".into())
        );
        for duplicate in message.walk_source(OWNER) {
            reject(&duplicate, &body, &filename);
        }
    }
    assert_eq!((body_calls.get(), filename_calls.get()), (0, 0));
    let mut origin_counters = Vec::new();
    for message in &origin_messages {
        let document = mfd051_native_guard_r7::prepare_native_x12_nullable_message(
            message,
            Some(&body),
            Some(&filename),
        )?
        .unwrap();
        origin_counters.extend(counters(document.value()));
        assert_eq!(
            message.source_document_path()?,
            Value::String("resolved-origin.x12".into())
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(origin_counters, ["1", "2", "3", "4"]);
    assert_eq!((body_calls.get(), filename_calls.get()), (3, 3));
    std::fs::write(
        path.with_extension("rust-guard-results.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(
            &serde_json::json!({"duplicate_unchosen_no_effects":true,"named_rejected":true,"named_interchange_alias_rejected":true,"grouped_rejected":true,"iterated_group_members_rejected":true,"basic_legacy_rejected":true,"origin_preserved":true,"counters":observed,"origin_counters":origin_counters}),
        )?,
    )?;
    println!(
        "entry preflight rejected duplicate/named/grouped frames before effects; origin and counters preserved"
    );
    Ok(())
}
